title: Botswana tourism visa service information baseline
statement: The official Government of Botswana tourism visa service page states that the service concerns recreational visits, identifies non-citizens from visa-required countries as eligible for the service, and describes application submission and outcome-check procedures.
evidence_excerpt:
This is issued to people who intend to visit Botswana for recreational purposes.

All non-citizens from countries that require visa to enter Botswana as tourists are eligible for this service.

Any immigration office, Botswana embassy or consulate may receive an in-person visa application with the required documents.

Applicants are instructed to check the outcome from the submitting office after seven to fourteen working days.
rationale: This assertion narrowly records service information present in immutable snapshot bc99cd44-b48d-4f3b-9492-ec9160d3f6e1. It does not assert nationality-specific visa requirements, legal entitlement, approval, guaranteed processing time, or complete Botswana immigration-law coverage.
